name: unhcr-refugee-data-finder

source.publisher: UNHCR, The UN Refugee Agency - asylum applications residing in each country of origin (annual), via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX)
source.vintage_last_modified: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:33:52 GMT (the HDX resource retains no historical vintages; this release pins the 2026-08-20 distribution, which carries complete data through year 2025)
source.requests_note: one anonymous GET of asylum_applications_residing_world.csv (8,669,567 B, sha256 d5808616c3d10d33925d4df5a3182a2028dd574d111e843cc207455ba45fe950); tokenless HDX download URL, no key
source.fetch_provenance: worker job unhcr-001 (server 172873699, cx23/hel1) fetched the publisher directly; the bytes never passed through the coordinator. The panel was first pinned at discovery on 2026-10-23 and the construction preflight re-fetched it on 2026-10-27 - byte-identical (same sha256), confirming the same vintage

grain: one row per origin-asylum corridor label year T = D+1, for corridors eligible at the last fully published year D (year-D government/procedure persons total >= 500 AND a published year-D-1 corridor value); 7,212 shipped rows

eligibility.excluded_breakdown: missing_history 377 (314 train: 192 panel-starts-2000 label-year-2001 rows + 122 no published year-D-1 cell; 31 eval; 32 holdout); host-files-no-gp-report unobserved_target 21 train / 7 eval / 5 holdout - censored, never labelled; live-edge target_year_beyond_vintage 496 counted separately
eligibility.live_edge_note: 496 eligible corridors for label year 2026 sit beyond the fetched vintage (no published year-2026 data exists yet); they are excluded and counted, never labelled

label.rule: doubled = 1 iff the corridor's year-T (= D+1) G/P persons total is at least DOUBLING x its year-D total (DOUBLING = 2)

fixture_events.source: the 2015 German asylum-application surge; asserted in-build from the fetched panel
high 2021 base keeps the 2022 total below 2x; asserted in-build
year-D (2021) corridor total 458 < MIN_APPS 500: the surge corridor is excluded by construction, not silently shipped

train.window: 2001-01-01 to 2017-01-01 (label years 2002-2016 shipped; label-year-2001 contributes no rows under the published-year-D-1 rule)

hazards_measured.cross_row_probe: next_label_year_exposes_outcome declared to the gate and executed on every split: a label-year T+1 row's surged_recently equals the label-year T row's label; coverage 2439/1265/1239 rows (train/eval/holdout), 0 mismatches - the reason the evaluation contract fixes access to isolated_rows
hazards_measured.publication_lag: measured 232 days: the 2026-08-20 refresh carries complete data through year 2025 (max Year = 2025 on the fetched bytes), 232 days after the 2025 period end; HDX update history observed 2025-11-05, 2026-02-25, 2026-06-11, 2026-06-19, 2026-06-22, 2026-08-20

full_model_stock_xgboost.source: worker job unhcr-baseline-001, benchmark runner verbatim (train.py and validate.py both print Eval AUC 0.5393; independent predict_proba recompute 0.53935)

persistence_momentum.source: log_growth_d, the corridor's own momentum observed at the instant

persistence_surge_flag.source: surged_recently, 1 when the corridor already doubled in year D

calendar_identity.source: train-fitted rate per (origin, asylum) corridor, falling back to origin, then the global train rate

recent_rate_constant.definition: train rate over the last three train label years; a constant score carries no ranking information

references_eval_1887_rows_165_positives.majority_rule: majority = int(train_positive_rate >= 0.5); accuracy measured against this split's labels

full_model_minus_persistence_momentum.reading: interval contains zero (inconclusive difference); observed gap negative - the stock baseline trails the corridor-momentum persistence reference

full_model_minus_recent_rate.reading: inconclusive; a constant reference has no ranking information, so this is a degenerate control recorded as such

prevalence_shift_note: positive rate by eval label year swings 1.4% (2020, pandemic collapse) to 18.8% (2021, rebound); train 8.42% -> holdout 11.57% across splits. The pooled eval AUC blends very different regimes; per-year figures above are the honest grain. A constant-rate reference cannot rank within a year; the calendar prior absorbs identity only.
headroom_finding: no demonstrated headroom over persistence under this protocol: the stock model trails both persistence references (0.5393 vs 0.5742/0.5856) and every paired interval contains zero. Recorded as the finding beside every model figure; one weak stock model does not establish that no solver can beat persistence, and no claim is made in either direction.

measurement_commands.baseline: runner-contract baseline job unhcr-baseline-001: gate --accept on the fetched bytes (ACCEPTED 6fa7becdf32925b7), then python train.py + sh validate.sh unmodified, then report.py (model per-row scores via predict_proba + paired bootstrap vs the references)
measurement_commands.majority_rule: majority = int(train_positive_rate >= 0.5); accuracy measured against this split's labels
